ideas.title: Nginx Closes a WebSocket Connection After the Upgrade Because the Timeout Is Too Low
ideas.description: Fix an Nginx reverse proxy that accepts a WebSocket upgrade but drops the socket during idle periods.
ideas.angle: Explain that a successful upgrade only establishes the tunnel; Nginx can still close it with proxy read and send timeouts. Show the required websocket proxy headers and the timeout settings that keep the connection open for idle traffic.

ideas.title: Remix Reads `process.env` in a Route Loader but the Variable Is Undefined in Production
ideas.description: Fix route loaders and actions that work locally but lose environment values after deployment or adapter changes.
ideas.angle: Explain how Remix adapters, build-time replacement, and server runtime differences affect environment access. Show how to read env vars from the correct runtime source for your adapter, and how to avoid inlining values that should stay server-side.

ideas.title: Astro Serves Broken Images After Deployment Because the Asset Path Points at the Wrong Origin
ideas.description: Fix deployed Astro pages that load HTML but 404 their CSS, JS, or image assets from an incorrect public path.
ideas.angle: Explain how Astro computes asset URLs from `site`, `base`, and the hosting path. Show how to set the correct origin and base path for the target host, and how to verify emitted links and rewritten references in the built output.

drafted.title: FastAPI Rejects a JSON Request with 422 Because the Pydantic Model Does Not Match the Payload
drafted.description: Fix a FastAPI validation error caused by field names, types, or nesting that do not match the incoming JSON body.
drafted.angle: Explain how FastAPI uses Pydantic to validate request bodies before the handler runs. Show how mismatched field names, missing nesting, optional types, and strict models produce a 422 response, then demonstrate the exact model and payload shape that must line up.
